articles.title: Snapchat takes aim at Partiful with new event-planning features
articles.description: Snapchat says the new features can be used to organize everything from birthday celebrations and sporting events to study sessions and weekend hangouts.

points: Snapchat's new event-planning features enable organization of birthdays, sporting events, study sessions, and weekend hangouts.
The features mark Snapchat'threat to specialized event planning services like Partful.

articles.title: Defense tech Mach Industries doubles valuation to $3.7B in 3 months
articles.description: The buzzy startup raised another $600 million in a Series C extension round, bringing the total of the round to $900 million.
articles.summary: In just three months, defense technology startup Mach Industries has successfully raised $90 endowed for its Series C funding round, bringing its total valuation to $3.7 billion.
points: Mach Industries, a defense technology startup, has raised $900 million in a Series C extension round.
The rapid raise has led to a doubling of the startup's valuation to $3.7 billion in just 3 months.
With this significant influx of capital, Mach Industries is well-positioned to continue its growth trajectory in the defense technology sector.
articles.insight: The impressive funding round reflects increasing investor confidence in the defense technology sector's potential for high returns. Mach Industries' success could indicate an expanding market for defense technologies and a trend of rapid scaling among startups in this niche.

articles.title: European founders and VCs urge lawmakers ‘to get EU Inc right’
articles.description: Amid negotiations for a new EU-wide corporate status, an open letter signed by unicorn founders and investors warns that 'EU Inc.' shouldn’t be watered down.
articles.summary: European tech founders and investors are advocating for a strong EU Inc. status amid ongoing negotiations. They warn that watering down the concept would harm European innovation and competitnership on a global stage.
points: A growing number of European founders and investors are rallying against watering down the EU Inc. status, with a letter to lawmakers expressing their concern.
The group behind the letter includes successful European tech companies (unicorns) and influential investors, seeking to influence the outcome of EU Inc. status negotiations.
The advocacy highlights the importance of a robust EU Inc. status to support European innovation and global competitiveness.
articles.insight: This news underscores the significance of a strong and cohesive corporate status for European tech companies in order to maintain and enhance global competitiveness. It also highlights the importance of government involvement in the success of the sector.

points: The US Army invested $11 million in Austin-based Tern.
Tern'devised an alternative to GPS, referred to as 'Google Maps for the battlefield.'

articles.insight: This investment suggests a growing recognition of the limitations of GPS in combat scenarios and a significant shift towards developing and adopting advanced, reliable, and secure positioning technologies to ensure operational effectiveness and security.
